audit_type: independently verified post-hoc historical candidate pair
warning: Both settings were selected after viewing Jan 2025-Oct 2026 results. Passing these periods is not true out-of-sample evidence. November has only one trade per strategy and is not a statistically meaningful forward test.

data.cost: 0.05% futures taker per side + GST 18% on trading fees +5 BTC points adverse slippage per side, stress additional 0/2/5/10bps per side
data.sizing: 0.5% of sleeve equity per 1R, max 5x notional

strategies.entry: Previous 1H close below lower Bollinger20 2sigma, RSI2 <=15, next completed bullish 1H re-entry above lower band, below SMA20; next 1m open
strategies.regime: 4H ADX<=45, 4H 8-bar efficiency<=0.70, abs(4H close - close three 4H bars ago) <= 1.5x 4H ATR

strategies.entry: Previous 48 completed 1H candles bound channel; range width 2.5-15x H1 ATR; current completed candle touches/rejects upper/lower boundary, enters toward range midpoint at next 1m open
strategies.regime: 4H ADX<=45, 4H 8-bar efficiency<=.70; completed 4H price within middle 50% of PRIOR 48 completed 4H bars channel

comparison.kind: synthetic monthly blend, not joint real-account backtest

requires_before_live: new unseen data with frozen parameters and min trade sample
trade-level shared-margin backtest and paper forward trading
